an8.14:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] aṭṭha ca bhikkhave assakhaluṅke desissāmi aṭṭha ca assadose, aṭṭha ca purisakhaluṅke aṭṭha ca purisadose,
an8.14:1.2: taṃ suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasi karotha bhāsissāmīti.
an8.14:1.3: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhu bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an8.14:2.1: katame ca bhikkhave, aṭṭha assakhaluṅkā aṭṭha ca assadosā:
an8.14:2.2: idha bhikkhave, ekacco assakhaluṅko ‘pehī’ti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā pacchato paṭisakkati piṭṭhito rathaṃ paṭivatteti.
an8.14:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, idhekacco assakhaluṅko ‘pehī’ti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā pacchā laṃghati kubbaraṃ hanti. tidaṇḍaṃ bhañjati.
an8.14:4.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, idhekacco assakhaluṅko ‘pehī’ti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā rathisāya satthiṃ ussajjitvā rathisaṃ yeva ajjhomaddati,
an8.14:5.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave idhekacco assakhaluṅko ‘pehī’ti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā ummaggaṃ gaṇhāti, ubbaṭumaṃ rathaṃ karoti.
an8.14:6.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, idhekacco assakhaluṅko ‘pehī’ti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā laṅghati purimaṃ kāyaṃ, paggaṇhāti purime pāde.
an8.14:7.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave idhekacco assakhaluṅko ‘pehī’ti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā anādiyitvā sārathiṃ anādiyitvā patodaṃ dantehi mukhādhānaṃ vidaṃsitvā yena kāmaṃ pakkamati,
an8.14:8.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave idhekacco assakhaluṅko ‘pehī’ti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā, neva abhikkamati, no paṭikkamati, tattheva khīlaṭṭhāyī ṭhito hoti.
an8.14:9.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave idhekacco assakhaluṅko ‘pehī’ti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā purime ca pāde saṃharitvā pacchime ca pāde saṃharitvā tattheva cattāro pāde abhinisīdati.
an8.14:9.4: ime kho bhikkhave, aṭṭha assakhaluṅkā aṭṭha ca assadosā.
an8.14:10.1: katame ca bhikkhave aṭṭha ca purisakhaluṅkā, aṭṭha ca purisadosā:
an8.14:10.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti.
an8.14:10.3: so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno na sarāmīti asatiyā va nibbeṭheti.
an8.14:10.4: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave, assakhaluṅko pehīti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā pacchato paṭisakkati piṭṭhito rathaṃ paṭivatteti.
an8.14:11.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti
an8.14:11.2: so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno codakaṃ yeva paṭippharati.
an8.14:11.3: kiṃ nukho tuyhaṃ bālassa abyattassa bhaṇitena
an8.14:11.5: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave assakhaluṅko pehīti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā pacchālaṃghati, kubbaraṃ hanti, tidaṇḍaṃ bhañjati.
an8.14:12.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti.
an8.14:12.2: so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno codakasseva paccāropeti
an8.14:12.3: tvampi khosi itthannāmaṃ āpattiṃ āpanno tvaṃ tāva paṭhamaṃ paṭikarohīti.
an8.14:12.4: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave, assakhaluṅko pehīti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā rathisāya satthiṃ ussajjitvā rathisaṃ yeva ajjhomaddati.
an8.14:13.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti.
an8.14:13.2: so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno aññenaññaṃ paṭicarati, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmeti, kopañca dosañca appaccayaṃ ca pātukaroti.
an8.14:13.3: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave, assakhaluṅko pehīti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā ummaggaṃ gaṇhāti, ubbaṭumaṃ rathaṃ karoti.
an8.14:14.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti.
an8.14:14.2: so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno saṅghamajjhe bāhā vikkhepaṃ bhaṇati.
an8.14:14.3: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave assakhaluṅko pehīti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā laṅghati purimaṃ kāyaṃ, paggaṇhāti purime pāde,
an8.14:15.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti.
an8.14:15.2: so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno anādiyitvā saṅghaṃ anādiyitvā codakaṃ sāpattikova yena kāmaṃ pakkamati.
an8.14:15.3: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave, assakhaluṅko pehīti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā anādiyitvā sārathiṃ anādiyitvā patodaṃ dantehi mukhādhānaṃ vidaṃsitvā yena kāmaṃ pakkamati.
an8.14:15.5: eva rūpopi bhikkhave, idhekacco purisakhaluṅko hoti.
an8.14:16.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti.
an8.14:16.2: so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno nevāhaṃ āpattomhi na panāhaṃ āpattomhīti tuṇhībhāvena saṅghaṃ viheseti.
an8.14:16.3: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave, assakhaluṅko pehīti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā neva abhikkamati, no paṭikkamati, tattheva khīlaṭṭhāyī ṭhito hoti.
an8.14:17.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti.
an8.14:17.2: so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno evamāha;
an8.14:17.3: kiṃ nukho tumhe āyasmanto atibāḷhaṃ mayi byāvaṭā, idānāhaṃ sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissāmīti,
an8.14:17.5: idāni kho tumhe āyasmanto attamanā hothā’ti,
an8.14:17.6: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave assakhaluṅko pehīti vutto viddho samāno codito sārathinā purime ca pāde saṃharitvā pacchime va pāde saṃharitvā tattheva cattāro pāde abhinisīdati.
an8.14:17.10: ime kho bhikkhave aṭṭha purisakhaluṅkā aṭṭha ca purisadosāti.
